Need statement: Place the load at the commanded angle.
Requirement text: Steady-state error after a 30 deg step shall be <= 0.5 deg.
Rationale: About 1.7% of the step; sets the accuracy the outer loop can assume.

Need statement: Respond fast enough for an outer guidance or attitude loop (notional outer-loop bandwidth 0.5 Hz).
Requirement text: Step overshoot shall be <= 3 deg (10% of a 30 deg step).
Rationale: Overshoot consumes travel and mechanical clearance.

Need statement: Respond fast enough for an outer guidance or attitude loop (notional outer-loop bandwidth 0.5 Hz).
Requirement text: The axis shall settle within +/-1 deg in <= 1.0 s.
Rationale: Settling several times faster than the outer-loop time constant (~0.3 s).

Need statement: Respond fast enough for an outer guidance or attitude loop (notional outer-loop bandwidth 0.5 Hz).
Requirement text: Closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth shall be >= 2.0 Hz.
Rationale: Flow-down: 4x separation from the 0.5 Hz outer loop (low end of the 4-10x rule of thumb). Relaxed from 2.5 Hz by CR-1 (see report, Section 6).

Need statement: Keep performing with realistic sensor noise, load, latency and part-to-part variation.
Requirement text: Loop phase margin shall be >= 45 deg.
Rationale: Standard minimum for well-damped response with margin for model error.

Need statement: Keep performing with realistic sensor noise, load, latency and part-to-part variation.
Requirement text: Delay margin shall be >= 20 ms, and SYS-002/003 shall still hold with 20 ms of added loop latency.
Rationale: Covers 10 ms of driver/bus latency with a 2x allowance.

Need statement: Keep performing with realistic sensor noise, load, latency and part-to-part variation.
Requirement text: Final-position spread over ten noise realisations shall be <= 0.2 deg.

Need statement: Keep performing with realistic sensor noise, load, latency and part-to-part variation.
Requirement text: Peak deviation during a 0.025 N m, 1 s load disturbance shall be <= 2.0 deg.
Rationale: Load is ~8% of the torque available at the 4 A current limit.

Need statement: Keep performing with realistic sensor noise, load, latency and part-to-part variation.
Requirement text: Error 1 s after the disturbance is removed shall be <= 0.75 deg.

Need statement: Keep performing with realistic sensor noise, load, latency and part-to-part variation.
Requirement text: SYS-001..004 shall be met in >= 95% of 200 randomised parameter sets (R +/-20%, Kt +/-15%, J +/-40%, friction +/-50%, noise 0.5-2x).
Rationale: Part-to-part and load-inertia uncertainty; nominal-only verification hides fragility.

Need statement: Fail to a safe state on sensor or driver faults and stay inside hardware ratings.
Requirement text: On loss or invalidity of feedback the controller shall command 0 V on every sample and the brake shall engage within 50 ms.
Rationale: Safe state when the controller cannot trust its position.

Need statement: Fail to a safe state on sensor or driver faults and stay inside hardware ratings.
Requirement text: A stuck (frozen) encoder shall be detected and drive removed within 100 ms of the controller commanding > 1 V (tested for onsets during the move, 0-0.12 s).
Rationale: A frozen sensor looks healthy to the PID; plausibility monitoring is required.

Need statement: Fail to a safe state on sensor or driver faults and stay inside hardware ratings.
Requirement text: For a stuck encoder at any onset time (0-0.6 s) the axis shall not reach the +/-90 deg hard stops (peak |angle| <= 85 deg).
Rationale: Avoids hard-stop impact. Met by monitor + fail-safe brake + independent limit switch (defence in depth).

Need statement: Fail to a safe state on sensor or driver faults and stay inside hardware ratings.
Requirement text: Applied motor voltage shall not exceed 12 V in any scenario.

Need statement: Fail to a safe state on sensor or driver faults and stay inside hardware ratings.
Requirement text: Armature current shall not exceed 5 A in any scenario, including blocked rotor and hard reversal.
Rationale: Driver rating of a notional 5 A; the driver current limit is set at 4 A (80% derating).

Need statement: Keep performing with realistic sensor noise, load, latency and part-to-part variation.
Requirement text: Steady-state motor command activity (RMS, 1-3 s of the nominal run) shall be <= 0.5 V.
Rationale: Encoder quantisation amplified by the derivative term causes chatter: heating, audible noise, wear.
